_doc: Level XP (scripts/match/xp_rules.gd, docs/decisions/0048-camps-and-xp.md). XP is a kill reward: nothing over time, nothing for damage (damage to Hunters only builds armor). share_r (m): the last hit's squadmates, alive or downed, this close to the killer get the same XP in full. knock: base + per_level x the victim's level. camp_mob: a camp monster's XP by kind (a camp's XP is the sum of its monsters; chief is the Camp Chief's Brute). stray: any other monster (the Blight's, wanderers, lair guards). boss: a lair boss, to the last hit's squad in range like any kill. boon: Boon of the Hunt (scripts/match/hunt_boon.gd): the Hunters a lair boss's or a `from` monster's kill pays get +dmg damage dealt and +speed move speed for secs s; knocking a holder passes the time left to the knocker's squad that the knock pays; one boon a Hunter, a second refreshes.
